B818.desc: Illuminate PowerLoss Light Mask2. These errors alert the driver.

B827.desc: Constant spark advance setting when setting basic timing (stock 12 degrees)

B828.desc: Constant spark advance setting when setting min throttle blade opening (actuator test #70)

B9F4.desc: Temperature above which spark scatter is active. For road racing, the MP cal has this set to 0xfe. This keeps the revs higher during shifts.

B9F5.desc: Spark Scatter Inhibit Time in 11ms per bit

B9F7.desc: Spark Scatter inhibited below this speed. The MP MTX cal has this value set to 0xfe33 to keep the revs high during shifts.

B9F9.desc: This is how much advance is added to increase engine speed.

BA0C.desc: This is how much advance is added to increase engine speed.

BA1F.desc: This is how much advance is added to increase engine speed.

BA32.desc: This is how much advance is added to increase engine speed.

BA8C.desc: Product is added to the coolant temp base advance.

BA9B.desc: Product is added to the coolant temp base advance.

BAAA.desc: Product is added to the coolant temp base advance.

BB93.desc: Input from the knock sensor that is above this voltage is considered Knock.

BBAA.desc: Retard rate from Knock, no boost. In half degreesn. MP Tune definition lists it at $1BB9; the code reads it at $BBAA.

BBB1.desc: Knock Limit in 1/2 degrees. MaxRetard = KNKLIM if throttle is above THRKNK and RPM is below KLMRPM

BBB2.desc: Delta above MINTHR for knock detect

BBBC.desc: Increase Rate. Recovery from Knock Retard. Rate is 1/2 engine degree every INCSRT+1 * 11ms. Use ONLY 0,1,3,7,f,1f,3f,7f or ff

BBBD.desc: Increase Rate. Recovery from Knock Retard. Rate is 1/2 engine degree every INCSRT+1 * 11ms. Use ONLY 0,1,3,7,f,1f,3f,7f or ff

BBD4.desc: This table is reduced by the value in #002b (0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, or 1) depending on the boost control routine. And the result is subtracted from the advance calculated by 8010 or 805b

BBEF.desc: The result of this table is multiplied by #002b (0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, or 1) and subtracted from the table at #8098

BC0A.desc: ff disables the Adaptive Knock Retard

BC32.desc: MP Tune definition lists it at $BC34; the code reads it at $BC32. The byte at $BC34 is the rpm limit MRPDRE.

BDBC.desc: Start fuel uSec = [ STRTFL * STRTFL * (1 - STFBAR - STFTMP) * EPPMUL + (BATOFF * 4) ] * 4

BDE3.desc: Coldest temperature accepted as input to STRTFL table - anything below this value will be replaced with this value

BE32.desc: Start fuel uSec = [ STRTFL * STRTFL * (1 - STFBAR - STFTMP) * EPPMUL + (BATOFF * 4) ] * 4

BE41.desc: Start fuel uSec = [ STRTFL * STRTFL * (1 - STFBAR - STFTMP) * EPPMUL + (BATOFF * 4) ] * 4. This table decreases fuel for each engine rotation while starting

BE5C.desc: Start fuel uSec = [ STRTFL * STRTFL * (1 - STFBAR - STFTMP) * EPPMUL + (BATOFF * 4) ] * 4

BE63.desc: Start fuel uSec = [ STRTFL * STRTFL * (1 - STFBAR - STFTMP) * EPPMUL + (BATOFF * 4) ] * 4. This decreases fuel slightly at higher altitudes to account for thinner air.

BE8A.desc: Delta modifier added to engine temp after a stall before key on. This is to approximate heat soak

BE95.desc: Max allowable temp for RUNTMP (heat soak approximation)

BE96.desc: Start fuel uSec = [ STRTFL * STRTFL * (1 - STFBAR - STFTMP) * EPPMUL + (BATOFF * 4) ] * 4. This allows fuel to decay gradually after the start-run transition.

BEA5.desc: Compensates for slower opening times of injectors with lower voltage.

BEB8.desc: DensityFactor for part throttle. Multiplied by MAP and the 3D table value.

BEBA.desc: Compensates for MAP pressure effect on differential fuel pressure.

C089.desc: EPP per amount for increasing multiplier

C08B.desc: EPP per amount for decreasing multiplier

C08D.desc: No of PTENRD below PTELMT that PT enrich must be to return to HOTMAP spark advance after maxed out

C166.desc: Fuel Modifier from coolant temp and time.

C29C.desc: Baro enrichment factor multiplier from MAP

C2AB.desc: Baro enrichment factor multiplier from RPM

C2CA.desc: Charge Temp Factor. Note that this is an unfiltered charge temp voltage, so higher numbers are lower temps

C2DD.desc: Charge temp enrichment factor multiplier from MAP

C2E8.desc: Charge temp enrichment factor multiplier from RPM

C2F3.desc: Positive Transient Enrich Trigger Level in volts times 0.02

C2F4.desc: Max Delta THR (THR-AVTHR-POSTRG) - value of $26 is .51 volts

C304.desc: MAP Delta required to trigger transient enrichment

C306.desc: Fake Delta Map Increase. AVMAP is set to (MAP-OCTAE) any time throttle is just opened.

C316.desc: Decel leanout factor - THR based. When Y is zero, factor is 1.00

C325.desc: Main trigger (Delta trigger level for THR leanout) - Delta THR. MP Tune definition lists it at $186B; the code reads it at $C325.

C326.desc: Second trigger - leanout inc toward 1 when between triggers

C327.desc: hysteresis about delta THR trigger levels

C337.desc: delta map trigger level for no incremental leanout

C338.desc: delta map trigger level for max leanout on decel

C339.desc: delta map hysteresis on trigger levels

C33B.desc: No map leanout if below this RPM

C33C.desc: O2CNTR inhibit after MAP/THR leanout is done (times 11 ms)

C353.desc: lean out time constant based on MAP

C35A.desc: Leanout Time Constant based on Delta THR - uses average throttle

C41B.desc: Min AIS pulse required to trigger enrichment (steps)

C449.desc: O2 is inhibited for this time when switching from rich idle to closed loop idle. MP Tune definition lists it at $802C; the code reads it at $C449.

C44A.desc: MP Tune definition lists it at $802D; the code reads it at $C44A.

C44B.desc: Open loop enrich factor when setting mechanical basic timing

C44C.desc: Open loop enrich factor when setting min throttle blade opening (actuator test #70)

C454.desc: LowLimitForInMiddleDetermination. Used for Reverting to openLoop, Setting fault21, outputting O2 level to miller tool

C455.desc: DelayTimeWhenGoingClosedLoop. o2 voltage must trigger timer, ie must gt O2TLMH or lt O2TLML.Each 1 is 2.8 sec, cannot exceed $7f

C46B.desc: O2 Range Of Authority MaxMultiplier=1+O2LIMH/512 (cannot be above $7f)

C46C.desc: O2 Range Of Authority MinMultiplier=.5+O2LIML/512 (cannot be below $80)

C46D.desc: Zero percent limit on lean O2CNTR if MAP gt BOOSTP and no PTE

C4CF.desc: Starting Temp to select hot or cold AM timer

C4D0.desc: AM temp inhibit time from coolant temp

C4E4.desc: Map Hysteresis At Map Cell Boundaries

C4E7.desc: RPM Delta for Idle RPM For Closed Throttle Cell

C4E9.desc: Number of Bits Change Per Update Within A Cell

C4EA.desc: EPPs Between Cal Change Update (Open Throttle)

C4EB.desc: EPPs Between Cal Change Update (Closed Throttle)

C4EC.desc: O2 Controller Deadband Limit For Updating Cells

C4ED.desc: O2 Controller Deadband Limit For Updating Cells

C4EE.desc: No Cell Update Above This MAP

C4EF.desc: No Cell Update And O2CNTR Held Below This Map. Set to 0xff to disable O2 feedback.

C4F0.desc: No Cell Update Above This RPM - in rpms/32

C4F1.desc: No Cell Update Above This RPM - in rpms/32

C4F2.desc: No Cell Update below PWMIN - this value times 4 uSec

C4F4.desc: AutoCal Range Of Authority where MaxMultiplier=1+AMLIMH/512 (cannot exceed $7f)

C4F5.desc: AutoCal Range Of Authority where MinMultiplier=.5+AMLIML/512 (cannot be below $80)

C51F.desc: Multiplied by total knock to calculate knock enrich factor.

C522.desc: If MAP + BARO exceeds MPSHOF, wait SHFDLT, then kill engine for TRNTM. Overboost - $ff to disable

C523.desc: If MAP + BARO exceeds MPSHOF, wait SHFDLT, then kill engine for TRNTM. Overboost - $ff to disable

C524.desc: Overboost shutoff duration - $ff to disable - stock $5a

C525.desc: Overboost Shutoff when Wastegate problem has been detected (should not disable this)

C56D.desc: Fuel Off RPM for bad MAP

C56E.desc: Fuel On RPM for bad MAP

C577.desc: High RPM to activate decel fuel shutoff. Should be lower than shutoff RPM Off point.

C578.desc: Low RPM to activate decel fuel shutoff. Should be lower than shutoff RPM On point.

C57D.desc: Decel AIS Delay after throttle closes when MAP is below DCLMN2

C57E.desc: Decel AIS RPM trigger (third AIS delay)

C583.desc: AIS motor startup position from engine temp

C5A5.desc: Idle Speed From Temp in park/neutral or manual trans

C5B0.desc: Idle Speed From temp in Drive, auto trans only

C64C.desc: Cold OffIdle AIS Positioning, Increases instantly, decreases after DLYOFI

C672.desc: Barometric compensation factor for AIS control

C808.desc: AIS Decel Addition to control MAP vs. RPM

C82A.desc: AIS Decel Offset correction due to baro effect

C83B.desc: Decel AIS Delay after throttle closes when moving

C888.desc: Switch point between Decel or Idle AIS control. Note there is also a 1.5 mph hysteresis

C88B.desc: AIS: Position electronics thinks motor is (at idle)

C88E.desc: AIS update rate when calibrating - rate=(CALRAT+1)*11ms (can be 0,1,3,7,f,1f,3f,7f,ff)

CB46.desc: EGR flow monitor (MonitorEgrFlow), first phase: MAP window low limit (high limit at $CB47). MP Tune long name: ExhGasRecircConstLoLimit18.

CB48.desc: EGR flow monitor, first phase: engine rpm window low limit (high limit at $CB49).

CB52.desc: EGR flow monitor, second phase: engine rpm window low limit. MP Tune long name: ExhGasRecircConstHiLimit17a.

CB53.desc: EGR flow monitor, second phase: engine rpm window high limit. MP Tune long name: ExhGasRecircConstLoLimit19.

CB54.desc: EGR flow monitor, second phase: throttle above MINTHR, window low limit. MP Tune long name: ExhGasRecircConstHiLimit19a.

CB55.desc: EGR flow monitor, second phase: throttle above MINTHR, window high limit. MP Tune long name: ExhGasRecircConst6.
